system.description:
Causes creatures in a coneshaped path to flee (saving throw vs. wands). There is a 60% chance that they will drop whatever they are holding. The cone extends 60 feet to a base 30 feet across. Holds 25 charges.

This wand cannot be recharged.

This wand is crafted from dark, polished wood, featuring a sleek and slightly curved design. At the end, it is adorned with a menacing skull motif, intricately carved and detailed. The skull's eye sockets glow faintly with an eerie light, while the shaft of the wand is etched with subtle, arcane symbols.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
